name: ARK: Survival Ascended
description: ARK: Survival Ascended dedicated server, installed anonymously with SteamCMD (about 12 GB). Dedicated servers are for personal, non-commercial use unless you have a licence from its publisher; read this game's README.

variables.label: Server name
variables.description: As players see it in the server list.

variables.label: Map
variables.description: The map's name with its _WP suffix: TheIsland_WP, ScorchedEarth_WP, TheCenter_WP, Aberration_WP, Extinction_WP…

variables.label: Join password
variables.description: Players need it to join. Leave empty for an open server.

variables.label: Mods
variables.description: CurseForge project ids, separated by commas ("928548,929420"). The server downloads and updates them itself when it starts.

variables.label: PvE
variables.description: Players and their dinos cannot hurt each other.

variables.label: Taming speed
variables.description: 1 is the game's own; 3 tames three times as fast.

variables.label: Harvest amount
variables.description: Resources gathered per hit. 1 is the game's own.

variables.label: Experience
variables.description: Experience earned. 1 is the game's own.

variables.label: Difficulty
variables.description: Sets the highest wild dino level: 5 for level 150, 1 for level 30.

variables.label: Day cycle speed
variables.description: How fast time passes. 1 is the game's own.

variables.label: Daytime speed
variables.description: How fast the day passes, on top of the day cycle speed.

variables.label: Nighttime speed
variables.description: How fast the night passes, on top of the day cycle speed.

variables.label: Max tamed dinos
variables.description: For the whole server.

variables.label: Egg hatch speed
variables.description: Higher hatches eggs faster. 1 is the game's own.

variables.label: Mating interval
variables.description: Time between matings: lower is sooner. 1 is the game's own.

variables.label: Baby maturation speed
variables.description: Higher grows babies faster. 1 is the game's own.

variables.label: Hardcore
variables.description: Player characters go back to level 1 when they die.

variables.label: Player damage
variables.description: Damage players deal. 1 is the game's own.

variables.label: Player resistance
variables.description: Higher means players take less damage. 1 is the game's own.

variables.label: Wild creature damage
variables.description: Damage wild creatures deal. 1 is the game's own.

variables.label: Wild creature resistance
variables.description: Higher means wild creatures take less damage. 1 is the game's own.

variables.label: Structure resistance
variables.description: Higher means structures take less damage. 1 is the game's own.

variables.label: Item stack size
variables.description: Multiplies every stack size. 1 is the game's own.

variables.label: Resource respawn period
variables.description: Lower respawns resources sooner. 1 is the game's own.

variables.label: Harvest health
variables.description: Health of trees, rocks and carcasses. 1 is the game's own.

variables.label: Player food drain
variables.description: Higher makes players hungrier sooner. 1 is the game's own.

variables.label: Player water drain
variables.description: Higher makes players thirstier sooner. 1 is the game's own.

variables.label: Creature food drain
variables.description: Higher makes tamed creatures hungrier sooner. 1 is the game's own.

variables.label: Offline raid protection
variables.description: Tribes cannot be raided while all their members are offline.

variables.label: Raid protection delay (s)
variables.description: Seconds after the last member leaves before the protection starts.

variables.label: Max tamed creatures per tribe
variables.description: 0 turns the limit off.

variables.label: Hit markers
variables.description: Hit markers for ranged attacks.

variables.label: Players per tribe
variables.description: 0 means no limit.

variables.label: No friendly fire (PvP)
variables.description: Tribe-mates, their creatures and structures cannot hurt each other on PvP servers.

ports.name: game
ports.label: Game
ports.description: Players connect over UDP. RCON listens on TCP on the same port and is only used by Pulsar on this machine.
